notes:
Account background: enterprise financial analytics vendor, heavy personalization and search workflows. On hosted Redwood since 2024-08; steady growth in token consumption after embeddings push. Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token CPU/GPU cost, plus Optimize to reduce unit economics via batching/quantization. Customer quote on 2025-01-22 demo: "We need predictable p95 + EU residency for our EEA clients — uptime and auditability are non-negotiable."

Commercial / renewal context: contract renewal Q2 2025. Customer wants Dedicated sizing recommendation and an amendment to add EU region + KMS integration. Pricing sensitivity moderate; willing to commit to 12–24 month reserved capacity if unit-cost improvements are clear. Looking for a clear ROI case from Optimize pilot.

Operational notes: SE Diego ran benchmark on 2025-01-22 (internal perf doc in Drive). Initial numbers show p95 ~120ms for chat-style flows on a small Dedicated profile, but embedding ingestion peaks require more capacity. Team asked about automatic model fallback and cross-region routing to preserve latency when EU capacity constrained.

Security/procurement: Legal has open questions on DPA and vendor sub-processing; security wants proof of SOC2 + options for customer-managed KMS. CSM Rachel leading success plan; will run Optimize pilot with product ops.

Sales signals: high likelihood to expand to Dedicated + Private for sensitive workloads. Upsell path: start Optimize pilot -> demonstrate 20–30% cost reduction -> close Dedicated reserved commitment + EU region add-on.

Notes style: snappy bullets, call IDs referenced, next steps short.
